title: 从汤品到橄榄球：他为何放弃CEO，当球队总裁
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Before he was in football, the football business had a very prevalent past in the food industry.
segments.zh: 在涉足橄榄球之前，他在食品行业有着丰富的从业经历。

segments.en: Right. And so when the commander's role team president opened up, what peaked your interest about it?
segments.zh: 没错。那么当指挥官队总裁职位空缺时，是什么引起了你的兴趣？

segments.en: That seems like a dramatic shift from food team president.
segments.zh: 从食品行业到球队总裁，这似乎是个巨大的转变。

segments.en: Well, other than being, you know, probably every 12 or 13 year old boys dream to work on a sports team,
segments.zh: 除了这是每个十二三岁男孩的梦想——在体育队工作，

segments.en: for me personally, there were a variety of things.
segments.zh: 对我个人而言，还有很多其他因素。

segments.en: And first of all, I should say, loved, you know, feel very lucky to have been able to spend the time I did with the Campbell's company.
segments.zh: 首先，我很幸运能在金宝汤公司度过那段时光。

segments.en: And that journey was an extraordinary gift.
segments.zh: 那段经历是一份非凡的礼物。

segments.en: And, you know, I was lucky enough that I had a great successor there, ready to go.
segments.zh: 而且我很幸运，有一位出色的继任者已经准备就绪。

segments.en: And thinking about the next chapter, my life and so many things in my life have revolved around sports.
segments.zh: 在思考人生下一章时，我生活中的许多事情都与体育相关。

segments.en: And my, you know, perspective was in this next chapter.
segments.zh: 而我的视角就聚焦在这一新篇章上。

segments.en: I wanted to try to go do something different, but I wanted to be able to bring some of the things that I had learned or that experienced in turning around businesses or transforming brands.
segments.zh: 我想尝试做些不同的事，但希望能运用我在企业转型或品牌重塑中学到的经验。

segments.en: And, you know, I couldn't have found a better owner in Josh Harris and what Josh has done consistently, what his vision was for the commanders.
segments.zh: 而且，我找不到比乔什·哈里斯更好的老板了，他始终如一的作为和对指挥官的愿景。

segments.en: I don't think there's any mystery. We were a team in transition on a lot of different levels.
segments.zh: 这没什么神秘的。我们在很多层面上都是一支处于过渡期的球队。
